svg.aria-label: 5D3 · EYELET BOARD LAYOUT — redrawn board layout diagram, layout-sheet drafting style
svg.text: Redrawn from Fender 'Deluxe' Model 5D3 drawing, page 1 of 2 (layout; page 2 is the schematic) — the sheet prints no Fender locating code — not a trace
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
